span.div:
STAGE 6: LEASE START
Lease manager creates entry for new lock:
resource=res_A, owner=svr_7, expires=NOW+30000
Adds to expiry priority queue
Next check scheduled in 100ms

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.div:
STAGE 7: RESPONSE TO CLIENT
API layer sends response to client:
status=GRANTED, token=1042, effective_ttl=30000
Client receives response and begins critical section

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.div:
STAGE 8: PERIODIC RENEWAL
Every 10 seconds (ttl/3):
Client sends Renew(resource="res_A", owner="svr_7")
Lease manager extends expiry: expires = NOW + 30000
If renew fails (network error, timeout):
Client retries 3 times with 500ms backoff
If all retries fail: client must assume lock lost
Client aborts critical section and stops accessing resource

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.div:
STAGE 9: RELEASE
Client sends Release(resource="res_A", owner="svr_7", token=1042)
API layer validates owner and token match registry entry
Raft log entry appended: DELETE resource=res_A, owner=svr_7
Once committed: lock registry removes entry
Lease manager removes expiry entry

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.div:
STAGE 10: WAITER NOTIFICATION
Lock registry checks waiter queue for resource
If waiters exist: notify next waiter (via watch / callback)
Waiter receives notification and starts acquisition from Stage 1

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.div:
STAGE 1: RECEIVE
Client sends Acquire(resource="res_A", owner="svr_7", ttl=30000)
API layer validates request format and authentication
Lock registry checks: resource name valid? owner ID valid? ttl in
range?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.div:
STAGE 2: PREPARE
Lock registry creates proposed entry:
resource=res_A, owner=svr_7, status=PENDING, ttl=30000
Prepares Raft log entry with the proposed state change

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.div:
STAGE 3: QUORUM VOTE
Leader appends entry to its Raft log
Sends AppendEntries RPC to followers
Waits for majority (2/3 or 3/5) to acknowledge
If majority acknowledges → entry is committed
If quorum not reached within timeout → FAILURE

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.div:
STAGE 4: TOKEN GENERATION
Fencing token generator atomically increments counter
new_token = atomic_increment(current_token)
Token value appended to Raft log entry
Token is durable once log entry is committed

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.div:
STAGE 5: APPLY TO REGISTRY
Lock registry applies the committed log entry:
Insert: resource=res_A, owner=svr_7, token=1042,
ttl=30000, expires=NOW+30000, status=HELD
Verify: resource was FREE (reject if already HELD)
